briefdescription.para: For a given quadratic addrec, generate coefficients of the corresponding quadratic equation, multiplied by a common value to ensure that they are integers.

detaileddescription.para: The returned value is a tuple { A, B, C, M, BitWidth }, where Ax^2 + Bx + C is the quadratic function, M is the value that A, B and C were multiplied by, and BitWidth is the bit width of the original addrec coefficients. This function returns std::nullopt if the addrec coefficients are not compile- time constants.

briefdescription.para: Helper function to compare optional APInts: (a) if X and Y both exist, return min(X, Y), (b) if neither X nor Y exist, return std::nullopt, (c) if exactly one of X and Y exists, return that value.
Helper function to truncate an optional APInt to a given BitWidth.

detaileddescription.para: When solving addrec-related equations, it is preferable to return a value that has the same bit width as the original addrec's coefficients. If the solution fits in the original bit width, truncate it (except for i1). Returning a value of a different bit width may inhibit some optimizations.

In general, a solution to a quadratic equation generated from an addrec may require BW+1 bits, where BW is the bit width of the addrec's coefficients. The reason is that the coefficients of the quadratic equation are BW+1 bits wide (to avoid truncation when converting from the addrec to the equation).

briefdescription.para: Let c(n) be the value of the quadratic chrec {L,+,M,+,N} after n iterations.

detaileddescription.para: The values L, M, N are assumed to be signed, and they should all have the same bit widths. Find the least n >= 0 such that c(n) = 0 in the arithmetic modulo 2^BW, where BW is the bit width of the addrec's coefficients. If the calculated value is a BW-bit integer (for BW > 1), it will be returned as such, otherwise the bit width of the returned value may be greater than BW.

This function returns std::nullopt if (a) the addrec coefficients are not constant, or (b) SolveQuadraticEquationWrap was unable to find a solution. For cases like x^2 = 5, no integer solutions exist, in other cases an integer solution may exist, but SolveQuadraticEquationWrap may fail to find it.

briefdescription.para: Let c(n) be the value of the quadratic chrec {0,+,M,+,N} after n iterations.

detaileddescription.para: The values M, N are assumed to be signed, and they should all have the same bit widths. Find the least n such that c(n) does not belong to the given range, while c(n-1) does.
This function returns std::nullopt if (a) the addrec coefficients are not constant, or (b) SolveQuadraticEquationWrap was unable to find a solution for the bounds of the range.
